cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I accept your apology for breaking the vase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. The vase was cheap. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the dog and me which part of that embarrassment we deserved.

mechanism: Copy a housemate's dog-scolding under a mistaken account of broken crockery, then expand the admitted breakage into the cost of A's borrowed certainty.
confusable: Not generic escalating blame: B must reveal that A copied the wrong confident accusation and A must conceal its confusion while demanding the deeper apology.
comparison: Misplaced blame and household repair rather than an absent audience and undisclosed recording.
seedUse: Retains vase, dog blame and embarrassment; makes the borrowed scolding explicit.
